Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game. The action continues in the Super Sixes as Zimbabwe will take on Sri Lanka on the 2nd of this month. That will be a really exciting game. Join us at 12.30 pm IST (7 am GMT). Cheers

Richie Berrington says it is an important win. Adds it was important to get early wickets and they even managed to get wickets in the middle orders. Shares they have a clear plan with the ball and the players are confident. On Brandon McMullen, Richie Berrington says he is a key player and is doing a fantastic job for the team. Reckons they are looking forward  to the next game. Ends by saying the young players and even the experienced players have stepped up.

Shai Hope says they are been let down in all three areas. Adds the conditions were in bowlers' favour and they should have done well with the early movement. Reckons more effort should be given in the field as they were so many errors. Tells the foundation and the preparation needs to get better. There are a lot of things to get better. Shares they will hope to finish the tournament in a positive way. On Scotland, Hope credits them, says they have discipline with the ball and will learn from them. Tells they are new as a group and need to understand each other.

Brandon McMullen wins the Player of the Match for his all-round performance. He says things were going his way and he made the most of the start with the ball. Reckons he was just give his best and win the game for team. Shares Matthew Cross took a lot of pressure away with the bat.
...Presentation next...

West Indies were just broken down as they just couldn't put a stand together. It came in late with Jason Holder and Romario Shepherd but that was never enough as West Indies ended with a way below-par score. Scotland took the traditional route. They were not much aggressive as they needed the two points dearly. For West Indies, a win was important to keep the hopes alive but this just puts the story to the bed. West Indies are out of the race for the World Cup.

A comfortable win for Scotland! For West Indies, they have missed out on the ticket to India for the World Cup. Hard to digest this one. Once who ruled the cricketing world will be out of international tournament this year. Scotland won it with the ball. They were just outstanding as they gave away no freebies anytime of the innings. Brandon McMullen started with the ball and late with a fine fifty helped to chase it down. It was made too easy by West Indies for Scotland.
FOUR! Scotland have done it! Length ball, outside off. Cross pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
